proofs.text: Read the hashes of `login RULE-1` in a project with a record; verify the rule, proof and test hashes are each 64 characters, the kind is `file` and the design hash is `none`

rule_text: The three hashes a signature binds come back together with the kind of the test hash and the pinned design hash of a design rule

tests.body:
def test_the_three_hashes_come_back_with_their_kind(self, proved):
        parts = sign_module.rule_proof_test_hashes(
            proved.root, 'login', 'RULE-1')
        rule_hash, proof_hash, test_hash, kind, design = parts
        assert len(rule_hash) == 64 and len(proof_hash) == 64
        assert len(test_hash) == 64
        assert kind == 'file'
        assert design is None
tests.name: test_the_three_hashes_come_back_with_their_kind
